title: Snowflake ontology: two checks
body_markdown:
##


Two checks


Snowflake’s[November 3 announcement](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/business-ontology-context/) describes Business Ontology as an upcoming preview.


Suppose agents return different revenue totals. Trace each answer’s approved definition, scope and linked Semantic View before changing the glossary: approved brand variants can legitimately differ.


A shared definition does not certify matching calculations. Ontology links meaning across views without changing their math; implementation stays with view owners.


Don’t edit a term to manufacture agreement. Confirm the intended meaning, then validate its implementation. This is our routing inference, not an accuracy test or access confirmation.
